beats.event: Henry Dashwood dies; his son John reneges on supporting the sisters
Widow and daughters move from Norland to modest Barton Cottage
Edward Ferrars visits Norland; grows close to Elinor before she leaves
Colonel Brandon becomes attached to sixteen-year-old Marianne
John Willoughby carries the injured Marianne home in the rain
Willoughby abruptly leaves for London; Marianne is distraught
Lucy Steele confides to Elinor her secret engagement to Edward Ferrars
Mrs Jennings takes the sisters to London for the winter season
At a ball Willoughby cuts Marianne, announces engagement to Miss Grey
Brandon tells Elinor of Willoughby's earlier seduction of his young ward
Ferrars family disinherits Edward for honouring his engagement to Lucy
Brandon gives Edward a parsonage so he can marry Lucy
Marianne contracts putrid fever at Cleveland and nearly dies
Willoughby arrives at night, confesses to Elinor he truly loved Marianne
Word arrives that Lucy has married Robert Ferrars, not Edward
Edward, freed, proposes to Elinor and she accepts
Marianne marries Colonel Brandon; the sisters settle as neighbours
